desc: The warp map from the second screen's Start menu (TTYD_COMPANION_WINDOW, Settings, Enhancements, Field, Warp map; TTYD_WARPMAP_AREA=gor): an area, a room, its safe spawn, A: the warp goes to the game as a tap (room and way in, over several taps) and the game warps there with the warp's own rules (portRoomWarpRequest) at the point its own Start menu could open; before, the second screen refused the map
log_must: \[warpmap\] the second screen's warp: gor_\w+ \(safe spawn\), sent to the game
